selection.rule: primary p in [0.1, 0.13]; every defensible specification (clustered two-way FE, collapsed 2x2) p >= 0.1; wild cluster bootstrap p >= 0.105 in the generator, base R and Python checks; first 60 passing, in seed order

pilot_set: the first 10 candidates meeting the selection rule after the 60 main datasets; never used in the main runs
